theater: 巴比倫城與幼發拉底河中游

battle.name: 巴比倫起義
battle.theater: 巴比倫城與幼發拉底河中游
battle.brief: 公元前626年，加勒底人那波帕拉沙爾在巴比倫舉兵，亞述王阿舒爾巴尼拔的胞弟沙姆沙什烏金隨即倒戈，幼發拉底河中游的圍城與斷糧戰打響，亞述對美索不達米亞的統治就此崩解。卡面是科林斯青銅盔：巴比倫無出土實例，但它對應的希臘重裝步兵裝備，隨希臘與卡里亞雇傭兵營服役於亞述與新巴比倫兩軍。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 公元前626年的起義發生在亞述帝國的核心行省巴比倫境內，爆發點是幼發拉底河中游的巴比倫城與城北的西帕爾。交戰一方是亞述帝國：中央在尼尼微，國王阿舒爾巴尼拔坐鎮行省與帝國防務，亞述的軍隊編制是常備的王家軍加上省區總督分率的分遣隊，步兵由弓手、投槍手、持矛者與重裝劍士混編，另有輕型戰車部隊、騎兵、工兵與攻城技師，軍中常備外來雇傭兵團。另一方是巴比倫王國與北方聯軍：加勒底人那波帕拉沙爾在巴比倫即位後，把加勒底部族軍、城區民兵與亞述陣前的逃亡者編為主力；巴比倫王沙姆沙什烏金率北方亞述各城的聯軍自北南下，兩軍一度在美索不達米亞中段對峙。第三方是米底王國：高原上的米底王賽亞克薩雷斯趁亞述北境空虛起兵，與那波帕拉沙爾結盟，兵鋒轉指亞述本土。域外方面，希臘城邦與卡里亞的商人和雇傭兵是雙方都能購買的軍力來源，希臘商人聚居的阿爾米納正是地中海與美索不達米亞之間的交會點。整場衝突因此呈現出帝國行省內戰、舊王國反攻與外國聯盟三者交疊的形態。
countriesEn: The revolt of 626 BC broke out inside the core province of the Neo-Assyrian Empire, Babylonia, with its flashpoint at the city of Babylon on the middle Euphrates and at Sippar to the north of it. One side was Assyria itself: the centre lay at Nineveh, King Ashur-bani-apal held the provinces and the imperial defence from the capital, and the Assyrian order of battle rested on a standing royal army supplemented by detachments under provincial governors, with infantry drawn up in units that mixed archers, javelin-men, spear-bearers and heavily armed swordsmen, together with a light chariot corps, cavalry, engineers and siege specialists, and with foreign mercenary regiments kept in permanent service. The other side was the kingdom of Babylon and its northern coalition: once the Chaldean Nabopolassar had taken the throne of Babylon, he organised his Chaldean tribal levies, the city militia and the deserters from the Assyrian front into a main force; Shamash-shum-ukin, king of Babylon, led a coalition of the northern Assyrian cities down from the north, and the two hosts at one point confronted each other in the middle of Mesopotamia. A third party was the Median kingdom: the highland king Cyaxares rose at the moment when Assyria's northern frontier lay empty, allied himself with Nabopolassar and turned his spear against the Assyrian homeland. Outside the region, the merchants and mercenaries of the Greek cities and of Caria were a source of military manpower that either side could buy, and Al Mina, where Greek traders congregated, was the point of contact between the Mediterranean and Mesopotamia. The conflict accordingly took the form of a provincial civil war, a counter-insurgency by an old kingdom and a foreign alliance all overlapping one another.
people: 加勒底人那波帕拉沙爾是這場起義的推手。他是比特雅金部族的首領，族地在幼發拉底河下游的沼澤地帶，早年以軍事首領的身分替亞述效力，公元前627年前後奪取北岸要塞西帕爾，公元前626年進軍巴比倫城，驅逐亞述另立的傀儡，自立為王，此後二十餘年以巴比倫之王的名號統治兩河下游，並在公元前612年與米底聯軍攻陷尼尼微。他的後繼者尼布甲尼撒二世在父親陣中已握有實際兵權，前609年那波帕拉沙爾死後即位，前605年正式統治整個近東，成為這場戰爭最長期的受益者。亞述方面，國王阿舒爾巴尼拔自前669年即位，與胞弟沙姆沙什烏金的反叛正面對峙：前626年他派兵進攻巴比倫，把圍城與反圍城拉到幼發拉底河兩岸，最後靠圍城的飢饉把巴比倫逼到門前，但同時又要應付北方聯軍、埃及的獨立與阿拉伯沙漠的戰事，兵力四散。沙姆沙什烏金本是埃薩洪頓指定分治巴比倫的王子，他以一個王的頭銜去挑戰亞述王權的繼承合法性，圍城約兩年後傳說他在城門開啟前死去，可能死於飢荒，也可能自盡。北方與西部各城的倒戈者組成聯軍，由他以巴比倫之王的名義號令。米底王賽亞克薩雷斯是關鍵的外援，他選擇與那波帕拉沙爾並肩，最終在尼尼微的攻堅中擔任主力。埃及法老普薩姆提克一世則收留了末代亞述王阿舒爾巴尼拔二世，讓亞述的政治生命延續到前609年。
peopleEn: The driving force behind the revolt was the Chaldean Nabopolassar, chief of the Bit-Yakin tribe, whose lands lay in the marshes of the lower Euphrates and who had long served Assyria as a military commander. Around 627 BC he seized the fortress of Sippar on the north bank, entered Babylon in 626 BC, drove out the puppet the Assyrians had set up, and made himself king; for more than twenty years afterwards he ruled the lower Tigris-Euphrates as king of Babylon, and in 612 BC he and a Median coalition stormed Nineveh. His successor Nebuchadnezzar II already held real military power in his father's camp, took the throne when Nabopolassar died in 609 BC, and from 605 BC ruled the whole Near East, becoming the longest-lived beneficiary of the war. On the Assyrian side King Ashur-bani-apal, on the throne since 669 BC, faced the revolt of his own brother Shamash-shum-ukin head on: from 626 BC he sent troops against Babylon and drew the siege and the counter-siege to both banks of the Euphrates, and in the end the famine of the blockade brought Babylon to the brink, yet at the same time he had to face the northern coalition, the independence of Egypt and a war in the Arabian desert, and his troops were scattered accordingly. Shamash-shum-ukin had been the prince whom Esarhaddon installed to rule Babylonia in the division of the crown; he used a royal title to mount a challenge against the legitimacy of the Assyrian succession, and after about two years of siege he is said to have died as the gates were about to open, perhaps of starvation, perhaps by his own hand. The defectors from the northern and western cities formed a coalition that he commanded in the name of king of Babylon. The Median king Cyaxares was the decisive foreign ally: he chose to stand shoulder to shoulder with Nabopolassar and carried the weight of the assault on Nineveh. The Egyptian pharaoh Psamtik I, for his part, took in the last Assyrian king, Ashur-uballit II, and so prolonged Assyrian political life until 609 BC.
kits: 卡面兵器是科林斯青銅盔，一頂約公元前650年的希臘全覆式青銅盔，開眼、護鼻與頰片一體成形，鑄件厚重，頭頂脊線明顯；它擋得住劈砍與撞擊，代價是視野被壓到極窄、聽覺受損，戴著者在方陣中幾乎只能靠同袍的背與肩判斷戰況，所以才有看得見的代價是戴它的人只能靠隊形活這句話。巴比倫的城防與攻守並沒有出現這種青銅盔：巴比倫人用弓、短矛、投石索、標槍與革木盾，亞述軍用弓、箭、鐵刃長矛、鎚、柳條與蒙皮盾牌、輕型雙輪或四輪戰車，工兵攜帶雲梯、撞柱、攻城塔與填壕用的土方器材，圍城時另有專門的攻城槌與繩索。真正把科林斯盔帶到美索不達米亞的是希臘與卡里亞雇傭兵：這類營伍自阿達德尼拉里第二世以來即在亞述軍中服役，後來新巴比倫的楔形文獻也記錄過伊奧尼亞風暴式的希臘營伍；他們裝備大圓盾、重裝矛與青銅盔，排成密集方陣衝鋒，與亞述散兵線的邏輯截然不同。巴比倫與亞述的補給同樣靠地面車隊與幼發拉底河船運：王道驛站、徵用牛車與沿岸村鎮的糧食是維持遠征的基礎，圍城的一方必須先把渡口與河道拿穩。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Corinthian helmet, a fully enveloping bronze helmet of about 650 BC with an integral visor, nasal and cheek pieces, a heavy casting and a pronounced crest rib. It stops a chopping blow and a blow from above; the price is an extremely narrow field of view and damaged hearing, and a man wearing it can judge the state of the fight in a phalanx only by the back and the shoulders of the man beside him, which is why it is said that the visible cost of the helmet is that the man who wears it can live only by his formation. No such bronze helmet appears in the defences or in the fighting at Babylon: the Babylonians used bows, short spears, slings, javelins and hide-covered shields, the Assyrians bows and arrows, iron-edged long spears, maces, wicker and hide-covered shields and light two- or four-wheeled chariots, while the engineers carried scaling ladders, battering rams, siege towers and the earth for filling the ditch, together with the dedicated siege rams and rope gear of a blockade. What actually carried the Corinthian helmet to Mesopotamia was the Greek and Carian mercenary regiment: units of this kind had served in Assyrian armies since the reign of Adad-nirari II, and Neo-Babylonian cuneiform records later attest Greek regiments of the gale-of-Ionians type; they equipped themselves with the great round shield, the heavy spear and the bronze helmet, charged in a dense phalanx, and followed a logic entirely unlike the loose battle line of the Assyrians. Supply for Babylon and for Assyria likewise ran on ox-drawn waggons and on river traffic: the royal road with its staging posts, the requisitioned ox carts and the grain of the villages along the banks were the base of any distant campaign, and a besieging army had first to secure the fords and the river.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術核心是幼發拉底河。巴比倫分為東西兩岸，兩岸之間靠橋與渡船相連，河道既是補給線也是攻擊通道，控制渡口等於控制戰局。公元前626年之後，亞述軍把主力壓向巴比倫城東北與北面，選擇圍城而不是強攻：封鎖城郊道路、切斷城東的耕地與灌溉渠、迫使城內消耗儲糧，同時以工程兵在城外築壘填壕，搭起箭塔與攻城塔做遠程壓制，試圖在攻城技術尚不能一口氣吞下城牆的年代裡，用時間換勝算。巴比倫守方則以城牆高度、護城與城內的穀倉、井水為依托，組織遠程反制與出城反擊，並在北方聯軍配合下反覆切斷亞述的攻城工程隊。聯盟方面，那波帕拉沙爾與賽亞克薩雷斯在公元前612年會師，兩支大軍分別由南面與東面壓向尼尼微，先在野戰中擊潰亞述的野戰主力，再合圍攻城，城市在洗劫中陷落。希臘雇傭兵營在這個體系裡扮演的是另一種角色：他們是少數能提供重裝步兵方陣衝鋒能力的單位，卻必須服從各自的僱主，雙方都靠他們在正面抵住對手、掩護工程兵接近。總體看，這是典型的圍城加聯盟式戰役，糧食、渡口與工期決定勝負。
tacticsEn: The tactical heart of this war was the Euphrates. Babylon lay on both banks, the two halves joined by bridges and ferries, so the river was at once the supply artery and the avenue of attack, and control of the crossings was control of the war. After 626 BC the Assyrian main force pressed against the north and north-east of the city and chose blockade over assault: sealing the roads outside the walls, cutting the cultivated land and the irrigation channels to the east, forcing the city to live on its stored grain, while the engineers raised earthworks and filled the ditch outside and built arrow towers and siege towers for long-range pressure, trying in an age when siege craft could not yet swallow the walls in one stroke to buy victory with time. The Babylonian defence rested on the height of the walls, on the moat and on the grain stores and wells inside the city, organised long-range counter-fire and sallies, and, with the northern coalition in support, repeatedly cut the Assyrian engineering teams loose. On the alliance side Nabopolassar and Cyaxares joined forces in 612 BC, and the two armies pressed on Nineveh from the south and from the east, first breaking the Assyrian field army in open battle and then closing in for the siege, after which the city was sacked. The Greek mercenary regiments played a different role in this system: they were one of the few sources of heavy infantry able to deliver a phalanx charge, yet they had to serve whoever employed them, and both sides used them on the front line to hold the enemy and to cover the approach of the engineers. In the end this was a war of blockade and of alliance, in which grain, fords and the time spent on the works decided the outcome.
data: 可核實的數字有限，以下幾組較為可靠。起義標誌的年份是公元前626年，即亞述王阿舒爾巴尼拔在位第九年；巴比倫圍城持續約兩年，據巴比倫編年史，圍城第二年因斷糧而出現飢荒，前623年前後城門開啟，這是本戰爭最明確的時長。終局有兩個明確座標：尼尼微於公元前612年被巴比倫與米底聯軍攻陷並遭劫掠，哈蘭於公元前610年陷落，末代亞述王阿舒爾巴尼拔二世逃往埃及，前609年死於彼處。城防與地理的數字來自考古與古典記述：尼尼微的城牆周長約十二公里，城區面積約七百五十公頃；巴比倫城牆周長約八公里，希羅多德記載其城為方形、每邊九十斯塔迪亞（一斯塔迪亞約一百零六公尺），牆高四十七肘、寬二十八肘，約合二十五米與十五米。距離上，巴比倫至尼尼微直線約四百四十公里，至西帕爾約六十公里，至哈蘭約七百公里；幼發拉底河在巴比倫河段的古地理重建中水面寬約六百米至一公里，渡河必須靠橋、浮筏或渡船，河道分叉與人工渠系使正面強渡極難。兵力方面，雙方的確切人數沒有留下可靠記錄，亞述與巴比倫的官方數字多為宣傳性誇大，只能作量級參考：亞述一次遠征可投入數萬步兵與數百戰車，新巴比倫的野戰軍同樣以萬人計，但具體編制不可考；希臘與卡里亞雇傭兵營的規模通常在數百至數千人。
dataEn: Only a limited number of figures can be verified, and the following groups are the most reliable. The revolt is marked by the year 626 BC, the ninth year of Ashur-bani-apal on the Assyrian throne; the siege of Babylon lasted about two years, and the Babylonian Chronicle reports famine in the second year of the blockade, with the gates opening around 623 BC, which is the clearest measure of duration available for this war. The end of the affair has two firm coordinates: Nineveh was taken and sacked by the Babylonian and Median coalition in 612 BC, Harran fell in 610 BC, and the last Assyrian king, Ashur-uballit II, fled to Egypt and died there in 609 BC. Figures for the fortifications and the geography come from archaeology and from classical description: the circuit of the walls of Nineveh is about twelve kilometres and the urban area about seven hundred and fifty hectares; the circuit of the walls of Babylon is about eight kilometres, and Herodotus describes the city as square, ninety stadia to a side, a stadia being about one hundred and six metres, with walls forty-seven cubits high and twenty-eight cubits thick, roughly twenty-five metres and fifteen metres. As for distance, the straight line from Babylon to Nineveh is about four hundred and forty kilometres, to Sippar about sixty and to Harran about seven hundred; the reconstructed width of the Euphrates at Babylon runs from about six hundred metres to a kilometre, so any crossing required a bridge, a float or a ferry, and the branching channels and the artificial canals made a frontal crossing extremely difficult. On strength of troops no reliable figures survive for either side, and the official Assyrian and Babylonian numbers are mostly propagandistic overstatements that can only be used as orders of magnitude: a single Assyrian expedition could commit tens of thousands of infantry and several hundred chariots, and the field army of Neo-Babylon Babylonia was likewise counted in tens of thousands though its exact organisation is unknown; the Greek and Carian mercenary regiments normally numbered from several hundred to a few thousand men.
cause: 起義的成因可以分四層。制度層：亞述自前八世紀起主宰兩河，阿卡德語系的巴比倫被降為行省，前689年辛那赫里布滅巴比倫，之後雖重建城市，稅賦與徭役卻加重，神廟經濟與灌溉維修的勞動負擔都壓在城鄉居民身上。繼承層：前681年埃薩洪頓把王位分給兩個兒子，前669年阿舒爾巴尼拔繼承亞述王位，沙姆沙什烏金只得到巴比倫的王位名分，永遠沒有繼承帝位的機會，這個安排本身就是矛盾。壓力層：前7世紀末西米里安聯盟大舉西征，一般認為摧毀了凡湖一帶的烏拉爾圖並深入安納托利亞，亞述被迫西撤並把兵力抽往敘利亞，幼發拉底河兩側出現真空；前629年平定埃及後，亞述又把主力投入阿拉伯沙漠的戰事，北方與南方的守備同時空虛。行省層：亞述強行遷徙被征服地區的人口，把西頓王族流放尼尼微，前677年引發西頓起義；對沙漠中的阿拉伯聯盟年年徵索貢賦，行省邊界因而反覆用兵。直接導火線在公元前626年：亞述在巴比倫另立的傀儡那波帕拉沙爾不接受，殺入城內奪位；沙姆沙什烏金趁亂自立為巴比倫之王，兄弟之間的內戰全面爆開，希臘與卡里亞的商人則發現自己可以趁亂更換僱主。
causeEn: The causes of the revolt can be read on four levels. The institutional level: Assyria had dominated Mesopotamia since the eighth century BC, and the Akkadian-speaking Babylon had been reduced to a province; Sennacherib destroyed Babylon in 689 BC, and although the city was rebuilt, the taxes and the corvee were made heavier, with the labour of the temple economy and of irrigation maintenance falling on the urban and rural populations. The level of succession: in 681 BC Esarhaddon divided the crown between two sons, and in 669 BC Ashur-bani-apal inherited the throne of Assyria while Shamash-shum-ukin received only the title of king of Babylon and never any prospect of succeeding to the empire, and that arrangement was in itself a contradiction. The level of pressure: towards the end of the seventh century BC a great Cimmerian or Scythian movement swept west, generally held to have destroyed Urartu and the Aramaean states around Lake Van and to have reached deep into Anatolia, forcing Assyria to withdraw westwards and pull its troops towards Syria; after the pacification of Egypt in 629 BC Assyria again committed its main force to a war in the Arabian desert, leaving both the north and the south thinly held. The level of the provinces: Assyria moved populations about by force, exiling the royal house of Sidon to Nineveh, which produced the Sidonian revolt of 677 BC, and the tribute extracted year after year from the Arab tribes of the desert frontier meant the border of the province had to be defended again and again. The immediate fuse was lit in 626 BC: Nabopolassar, whom Assyria had installed in Babylon in place of its own man, would not accept it and took the city by force; Shamash-shum-ukin used the confusion to proclaim himself king of Babylon, the war between the brothers broke out in full, and the Greek and Carian merchants discovered that in the confusion they could change employers.
impact: 這場起義的後果超出了巴比倫一城。亞述帝國就此走向終點：公元前612年尼尼微陷落後，帝國的中樞與皇家檔籍一起化為灰燼，公元前610年哈蘭失守，最後一位國王靠埃及庇護苟延數年，到前609年亞述作為國家的歷史正式結束，其在新巴比倫統治下淪為短命的抵抗殘部。這也把兩河流域送入新巴比倫時代：那波帕拉沙爾與尼布甲尼撒二世先後統治，前567年尼布甲尼撒二世攻入埃及、前586年攻陷耶路撒冷，巴比倫以帝國的規模重建城牆與神廟，前604年尼布甲尼撒二世立巴比倫神為萬國之王，其名聲隨尼布甲尼撒時代的傳奇一路傳到希臘與地中海。希臘世界從這場戰爭得到的更多：前624年波斯進軍巴比倫時，希臘城邦趁亂聯合，使城邦間的合作成為通行的政治方案；希臘作家筆下的巴比倫，那篇用奇觀堆疊的城牆與水渠記載，成為西方對東方最古老也最長久的想像。同時，希臘與卡里亞的雇傭兵在兩強之間的反覆轉手，讓地中海世界第一次明白職業軍團可以整批外購，這正是後來希臘化時代傭兵制度的遠因。在兵器史的層面，這場戰爭標誌著亞述鐵器化軍裝與希臘青銅重裝兵的最後對撞：科林斯青銅盔的形制在公元前6世紀的東地中海仍在使用，但它的戰術價值始終綁在方陣上，而亞述與巴比倫的戰爭機器早已靠工程兵、圍城與投射武器取勝。
impactEn: The consequences of the revolt reached far beyond the one city of Babylon. The Neo-Assyrian Empire was driven towards its end: after the fall of Nineveh in 612 BC its capital and the royal archive were burnt together, Harran was lost in 610 BC, and the last king survived for a few years under Egyptian protection until his death in 609 BC, when Assyria's existence as a state formally came to an end and it sank into a short-lived rump of resistance under Babylonian rule. This also carried Mesopotamia into the Neo-Babylonian age: Nabopolassar and then Nebuchadnezzar II ruled in turn, the latter entered Egypt in 567 BC and took Jerusalem in 586 BC, and Babylon rebuilt its walls and temples on an imperial scale, with Nebuchadnezzar II in 604 BC raising the god of Babylon to the lordship of all nations, a fame that travelled with the Nebuchadnezzar legends into Greece and the Mediterranean. The Greek world got more out of the war than the Babylonians did: when the Persians invaded Babylonia in 624 BC the Greek cities closed ranks together, and co-operation between the poleis became the standard political remedy; the Babylon of the Greek writers, that pile of curiosities in Herodotus with its walls and its watercourses, became the oldest and most durable image of the East possessed by the West. At the same time the repeated passing of Greek and Carian mercenaries from one master to the other taught the Mediterranean world for the first time that a professional army could be bought in wholesale, which is the distant cause of the mercenary system of the Hellenistic age. At the level of the history of weapons the war marks the last collision between the iron-armed soldier of Assyria and the Greek bronze heavy infantry: the form of the Corinthian helmet was still in use in the eastern Mediterranean in the sixth century BC, but its tactical value was bound to the phalanx, while the war machine of Assyria and Babylon had long since won through engineers, blockade and missile weapons.
result: 公元前626年那波帕拉沙爾在巴比倫城即位，亞述對巴比倫的行省體制當場崩潰；沙姆沙什烏金的聯軍在巴比倫城與幼發拉底河兩岸與亞述軍對峙約兩年，圍城與飢饉把他的聯盟耗盡，他本人死於圍城末期，前623年前後城門開啟，亞述軍一度重入巴比倫，但巴比倫的獨立已成定局。此後阿舒爾巴尼拔回師北方，卻在公元前627年之後再無力同時應付北線、埃及與阿拉伯三處戰場。真正的終局由聯盟完成：公元前612年那波帕拉沙爾與賽亞克薩雷斯的聯軍攻入尼尼微，亞述野戰主力在會戰中被擊潰，城市陷落並遭洗劫；公元前610年哈蘭淪陷，末代國王逃入埃及，前609年死於那裡，亞述帝國宣告終結。米底人取得獨立高原王國的地位，新巴比倫則接管兩河下游，尼布甲尼撒二世在父親留下的軍隊與制度上繼續擴張，把亞述的行政與工程傳統保存並放大。從軍事上算，這場戰爭是圍城取城與聯盟攻國兩種辦法的合流：糧道、渡口、投射武器與僱兵決定了勝負，而美索不達米亞的兩大城尼尼微與巴比倫就此交換了樞紐地位。
resultEn: In 626 BC Nabopolassar took the throne in the city of Babylon and the Assyrian provincial system there collapsed on the spot; the coalition of Shamash-shum-ukin stood against the Assyrian army at Babylon and on both banks of the Euphrates for about two years, and the siege and the famine wore his coalition out, and he himself died at the end of the blockade, the gates opening around 623 BC and the Assyrians re-entering the city for a time, though the independence of Babylon was already settled. Ashur-bani-apal then turned back to the north, but after 627 BC he was never again strong enough to face the northern front, Egypt and the Arabian theatre at once. The real conclusion was reached through the alliance: in 612 BC the coalition of Nabopolassar and Cyaxares entered Nineveh, the Assyrian field army was broken in open battle, the city fell and was sacked; Harran was lost in 610 BC, the last king fled into Egypt and died there in 609 BC, and the Assyrian Empire was declared at an end. The Medians gained an independent highland kingdom, and Neo-Babylonia took over the lower Tigris-Euphrates, with Nebuchadnezzar II continuing and enlarging the expansion on the army and the institutions his father had left behind. Militarily, this war was the confluence of two methods, taking a city by blockade and bringing down a state by alliance: grain routes, fords, missile weapons and mercenaries decided the outcome, and the two great cities of Mesopotamia, Nineveh and Babylon, exchanged their place as the hinge of the region.
